notes.system: Third PDZ domain of PSD-95 (1BE9 chain A, 302-402) with the CRIPT peptide KQTSV (chain B), which is the ligand: 'chain:B'. Experimental reference: the effect of every single substitution on CRIPT binding (McLaughlin et al., Nature 2012) and the 21-fold loss of affinity on removing helix alpha3, residues 396-402 (Petit et al., PNAS 2009).
notes.purpose: Pilot, before any mutant: how long must a simulation be for the site to be sampled, and how different are two WT simulations? The only scenario is the modelled-WT control (silent K355K), so the panel holds 4 WT and 4 modelled-WT trajectories: 6 WT-vs-WT pairs.
notes.what_to_read: sampling_ok / effective samples of every run, the spread of the WT-vs-WT pairs (null_control), and whether wt_model stays inside it.
notes.cost: 8 simulations of 25 ns (1251 frames each), about 17000 atoms per system.
notes.to_extend: Raise prod_steps and launch again: finished simulations are extended, not repeated.
